column1: # Sticky 32 MB flash. Both app slots end below 16 MB: the ESP32-S3 maps only the first 16 MB (24-bit)
# past 0x1000000 fails the check before an OTA switches to it (default_32MB put app1 at 0xC90000). nvs
# spiffs (unused) and coredump keep their default_32MB offsets
column2: so settings survive the one USB install.
